chunks: And Abul Abbas Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'eed informed us, saying: Humeed ibn Ziyad narrated to me from his book and I read it to him, saying: Ja'far ibn Isma'il al-Minqari narrated to me, from Abdurrahman ibn Abu Najran, from Isma'il ibn Ali al-Basri, from Abu Ayyoob al-Mu'addib, from his father - who was a teacher for some of the children of Ja'far ibn Muhammad - saying: When the Messenger of Allah died, a man from the descendants of David, upon the religion of Judaism, entered the city,

he saw the streets empty, so he said to some of the people of the city: 'What is your condition?' It was said to him: 'The Messenger of Allah has died.' He said: 'Indeed, he has died on the day that is in our Book.' Then he said: 'Where are the people?' It was said to him: 'In the mosque.' He came to the mosque, and there were Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Abdurrahman ibn Awf, Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah, and the people, and the mosque was crowded with them,

he said: 'Make way so I may enter and lead me to the one whom your prophet has left in charge.' They led him to Abu Bakr. He said to him: 'I am from the descendants of David, upon the religion of Judaism, and I have come to ask about four things. If you inform me of them, I will become Muslim.' They said to him: 'Wait a little.' Then Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib came from one of the gates of the mosque, and they said to him: 'Go to the young man.'

He stood up to him, and when he drew near, he said to him: 'Are you Ali ibn Abi Talib?' Ali said to him: 'Are you so-and-so, son of so-and-so, son of David?' He said: 'Yes.' Ali took his hand and brought him to Abu Bakr. The Jew said to him: 'I asked these people about four things, but they directed me to you to ask you.' He said: 'Ask.'

He said: 'What was the first word/letter that Allah spoke to your prophet when he was taken on the Night Journey and returned from his Lord? And inform me about the angel who pushed your prophet away and did not greet him? And inform me about the four men from above whom Malik uncovered a layer of Fire and who spoke to your prophet? And inform me about the pulpit of your prophet, which position in Paradise is it?'

Ali said: 'The first thing Allah spoke to our prophet was the saying of Allah the Exalted: "The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and the believers. All have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], 'We make no distinction between any of His messengers.' And they said, 'We hear and we obey.' [Seeking] His forgiveness. And to Allah is the final destination."'

He said: 'This is not what I meant.' He said: 'Then it is the saying of the Messenger of Allah: "The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and the believers. All have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], 'We make no distinction between any of His messengers.' And they said, 'We hear and we obey.' [Seeking] His forgiveness. And to Allah is the final destination."'

He said: 'This is not what I meant.' He said: 'Let the matter be hidden.' He said: 'You must inform me, or you are not the one.' He said: 'Since you insisted, indeed when the Messenger of Allah returned from his Lord, and the veils were raised for him before he reached the place of Gabriel, an angel called to him: "O Ahmad!"'

He said: 'Allah sends you His greetings and says to you: "Deliver Our greetings to the Master, the Guardian." The Messenger of Allah said: "Who is the Master, the Guardian?" The angel said: "Ali ibn Abi Talib." The Jew said: 'You are truthful by Allah, and I find that in my father's book.'

Ali said: 'As for the angel who pushed the Messenger of Allah, it was the Angel of Death. He came from an arrogant one of the people of the world who had spoken a great word, so Allah became angry. He pushed the Messenger of Allah and did not recognize him. Gabriel said: "O Angel of Death, this is the Messenger of Allah, Ahmad, the beloved of Allah,"'

he returned to him, clung to him, and apologized, saying: "O Messenger of Allah, I went to a tyrant king who spoke a great word, so I became angry and did not recognize you." He accepted his apology. As for the four men from above whom Malik uncovered a layer of Fire, indeed the Messenger of Allah passed by Malik, who had not smiled since he was created,

Gabriel said to him: "O Malik, this is the Prophet of Mercy, Muhammad." So he smiled at his face and did not smile at anyone else. The Messenger of Allah said: "Order him to uncover a layer of Fire." He uncovered it, and there were Qabeel, Nimrod, Pharaoh, and Haman,

they said: "O Muhammad, ask your Lord to return us to the worldly life so that we may do good." Gabriel became angry and said with a feather from his wing, and he returned the layer of Fire upon them. As for the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah, his abode is the Garden of Eden, which is a garden Allah created with His Hand, and with him in it are twelve successors,

and above it is a dome called the Dome of Radwan, and above the Dome of Radwan is a house called Al-Waseela, and there is no house in Paradise that resembles it, and it is the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah.

Then he took out a book containing what he had mentioned, written in the handwriting of David, and said: 'Extend your hand, and I will witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and that he is the one about whom Moses gave glad tidings, and I witness that you are the scholar of this ummah and the successor of the Messenger of Allah.'
So Amir al-Mu'minin taught him the laws of the religion.
ai.seo_question: What are the four questions asked by the Jew to Imam Ali regarding the Prophet's ascension and Paradise?
ai.summary: This narrative from Al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights Imam Ali’s (as) unique authority in interpreting esoteric signs, serving as a proof of his designation as the 'Wasi' and inheritor of prophetic knowledge. The Jew’s verification of these details against the lineage of David underscores the continuity of divine revelation and positions Ali as the living embodiment of the Quranic command to 'obey those in authority' (Ulul-Amr).

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (30) Abul Abbas Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed narrated from Hameed bin Ziyad from Ja’far bin Issma’eel al-Minqari from Abdurrahman bin Abu Najran from Issma’eel bin Ali al-Basri from Abu Ayyoob al-Mu’addib that his father, who was a teacher (mu’addib) of some of Imam Ja’far bin Muhammad as-Sadiq’s children, had said: “When the Prophet (S) died, a Jew man of the descendants of Dawood (Prophet David) came to Medina and saw the streets empty.

He asked what the matter was. It was said to him that the Prophet (S) had died. He said: “Indeed he has died on the same day mentioned in our Book.” Then he asked where people were. It was said to him that they had been in the mosque. He came to the mosque where there were Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Abdurrahman bin Ouff, Abu Obayda bin al-Jarrah and a great crowd of people.

He said: “Make way to let me come in and lead me to the one, whom your prophet has entrusted with his umma!” They led him to Abu Bakr. He said to Abu Bakr: “I am a Jew and I am from the descendants of Prophet David (as). I have come to ask about four things. If you answer me, I become a Muslim.” He was asked to wait a little. Then Amirul Mo’mineen Ali (as) came in from one of the gates of the mosque. People said to the Jew: “Go to this young man!”

When he came near to him, he asked: “Are you Ali bin Abu Talib?” Imam Ali (as) said to him: “Are you so-and-so the son of David (as)?” He said: “Yes, I am.” Imam Ali (as) took the Jew’s hand and came with him to Abu Bakr. The Jew said to Imam Ali (as): “I asked these people about four things but they sent me to you.” Imam Ali (as) said: “Please ask!”

The Jew asked: “What was the first thing that was revealed to your prophet when he came back from his Lord after his Ascension? Who was the angel that pushed your prophet away and did not greet him? Who were the four men, from above whom Angel Malik had removed a cover of Fire and who had talked with your prophet? In which position of Paradise will the minbar of your prophet be?”
Imam Ali (as) said: “The first thing that Allah has revealed to our prophet after the Ascension is: (The messenger believes in what has been revealed to him from his Lord).”
The Jew said: “It is not this that I mean.” Imam Ali (as) said: “Then it is (and (so do) the believers; they all believe in Allah).”

He said: “It is not this that I mean.” Imam Ali (as) said: “Then let the matter be hidden.” The Jew said: “You are to tell me the truth. Are you not the one, whom I mean?” Imam Ali (as) said: “As you insist on that, I shall tell the truth. When the Prophet (S) came back from his Lord, where the screens were opened before him, and before he got to the place of Gabriel, an angel had called: “O Ahmad!”

The Prophet (S) said: “Here I am.” The angel said: “Allah sends you His greeting and says to you: “Deliver Our greeting to the master of guardians.” The Prophet (S) asked: “Who is the master of guardians?” The angel replied: “He is Ali bin Abu Talib.” The Jew said to Imam Ali (as): “You are right. I have found that in my father’s book.”

Imam Ali (as) said: “As for the angel, who had pushed the Prophet (S) away, he was the Angel of Death. He had come from an arrogant of the people of the earth, who had uttered something that made Allah angry. Then Gabriel said to the Angel of Death: “This is Ahmad, the beloved messenger of Allah.”

The Angel of Death came back, embraced the Prophet (S), apologized and said to him: “O messenger of Allah, I went to a tyrant king, who uttered bad things that made me very angry so that I did not know you.” The Prophet (S) accepted his apology. As for the four men, from above whom Angel Malik had removed a cover of Fire, that when the Prophet (S) passed by Angel Malik, who had never smiled since he had been created at all,

Gabriel said: “O Malik, this is Muhammad, the prophet of mercy.” Then Malik smiled to the Prophet (S) and he did never smile to anyone else than Muhammad (as). The Prophet (S) said to Gabriel: “Order him to uncover a layer of Fire!” He uncovered a layer of Fire and there appeared Qabeel (Cain), Nimrod, Pharaoh and Haman.

They said: “O Muhammad, ask your god to send us back to the worldly life in order to do good!” Gabriel became angry and with a feather of his wing he returned the layer of Fire upon them. As for the minbar of the Prophet (S), the abode of the Prophet (S) is the Garden of Eden, which Allah has created with His (hand). There are twelve guardians will be with the Prophet (S) in this Garden.

Above this abode there is a dome called the dome of ar-Radhwan (contentment). Above the dome there is a house called al-Wasseela (the means), which no house in Paradise looks like it. It is the minbar of the Prophet (S).” The Jew said: “By Allah, you are right. This has been mentioned in the book of my father David (as). The book has been inherited by one after the other until it has reached me.”

Then he took out a book written by Prophet David (as) and said to Imam Ali (as): “Give me your hand! I witness that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is the messenger of Allah. It is he, of whom Prophet Moses (as) has informed. And I witness that you are the jurisprudent of this umma and the guardian of the messenger of Allah.”

Then Imam Ali (as) began to teach him the laws of Islam.” The Book of Allah, the traditions of the Prophet (S), Imam Ali (as) and all the imams one after the other had confirmed that the number of the imams is twelve. No one among the Shia denies that the book of Sulaym bin Qayss al-Hilali is considered as one of the important books of the doctrine of the Shia. All that is mentioned in the book has been narrated from the Prophet (S), imam Ali (as), al-Miqdad, Salman al-Farisi Abu Tharr and their likes, who have accompanied the Prophet (S) and Amirul Mo’mineen (as). It is one of the sources that the Shia have depended on and referred to.
